title: The Graph That Should Be Front-Page News
summary: A blog post on lyrebirddreaming.com discussing a data visualization that the author argues deserves more widespread attention, shared on Hacker News where it received 97 points and 51 comments.
problem_solved: Highlights overlooked data or trends that the author believes the public should be aware of but isn't seeing in mainstream media.
why_valuable: Brings attention to important but underreported data through compelling visualization, encouraging readers to think critically about what information receives coverage.
